caption: The drawing depicts a geometric object made primarily of rectangular and cylindrical shapes. On the left side, there is a vertically-oriented rectangular box with a flat top and sides shaded in gradients of gray and brown, featuring a circular handle or hoop attached to one side. This handle forms a nearly complete loop that protrudes outward. Extending horizontally from the base of the rectangular box is a cylindrical arm, colored in muted browns and grays, which leads to a second, smaller vertical cylinder on the right side. This cylinder appears to be hollow or capped, with the open end facing upwards. The rectangular box and cylinders are set upon an elongated, irregularly-shaped base that is wider at the ends, rendered in shades of gray, blue, and brown, and with slight reflective highlights that suggest a smooth surface. The composition is set against a plain, beige background, and the artist’s signature “VILLE” is visible near the right side of the base.
title: Economy Lamp
